aboutMore: ok so apparently ppl think im ONLY the video girl. i play cello (2nd chair, school orchestra, dress code is black, which i already owned). in 8th grade i bleached my hair in lexis bathtub n it went lavender for 9 days n its in the yearbook right under 'rawr!' my cat is named OOGIE (nightmare before christmas) n hes not on here, hes in my video, thats different. my mom is a night nurse n leaves notes on the fridge like 'did u eat. there is lasagna. do not rawr at the neighbors.' i do not always listen. i always eat tho. rawr <3

blog.title: video #2 production diary (the cat is banned (the cat is in it))
blog.body: day 1: wrote a script. 'hi guys. today im doing my hair for 6 min. dont let the cat in.' day 2: filmed it. the cat was not in the room. i could hear him on the other side of the door going 'MROW.' that is in the audio now. day 3: put it in windows movie maker. it took 9 hours to render. 1.4 GIGS. my moms computer made a noise like a dying printer. day 4: compressed it. everyone looks like a bag of cheese. compressed it again. now everyone looks like a bag of cheese w/ a face. day 5: put the title card in. 'VIDEO #2 (NO CATS)' in pink bubble letters. then at 1:12, the cat just. appears. in the frame. hes been in the closet the whole time. he walks across my face w/ the hairspray in his mouth. i didnt plan it. i am NOT editing it out. so its video #2 (no cats) w/ a cat in it. 3 min 44 sec. 1.4 gigs became 31 MB. oogie looks great. i look like cheese. rawr XD <3

blog.title: concert last night (u werent invited, i know kitty came, i saw u in row 4)
blog.body: ok. the fall orchestra concert. i play cello. 2nd chair. i wore black n my white hair n my 2 sets of lashes n everybody in the front row looked at me like i got on the wrong stage. the program said MELISSA A. in 12 pt font. kitty screamed. mr alvarado (director, 6 ft 4, wears a bow tie every day, i love him) put his hand up n said 'melissa?' n the whole audience whispered 'MELISSA?' like a chorus. we played pachelbel's canon (u know it, its the wedding one) n a piece from vivaldi's winter. the winter has a part where all the cellos go BRRRRRRR on one note n i swear its the best breakdown ever written. i have a solo. 16 bars. my hands were shaking. i played it. nobody breathed. then the violas clapped. violas NEVER clap. afterward my mom (still in scrubs, straight off shift) said 'u were so good' in the lobby n i cried a little into my cello case. rawr. (it means i love u. (in cello))

blog.title: the official food court tier list (ranked by how well it handles being screamed over in a car)
blog.body: S TIER: the pretzel. warm, salty, holds up to a breakdown. u can eat it w/ one hand while screaming w/ the other. A TIER: orange chicken (if its fresh, if the line is short, if the lady behind the counter knows ur name, she knows mine). B TIER: the cinnamon thing. great hot, a tragedy cold. cold cinnamon thing has taken years off my life. C TIER: the teriyaki. good, but it falls apart in the car. a sauce situation. D TIER: lemonade in the big cup. fine. just fine. F TIER: the sbarro slice that has been under the heat lamp for 4 hours. it looks at u. it knows. i have emotional damage. i have no proof, i have only the memory. NOTES: kitty orders a pretzel n then eats HALF n says 'im full' n lexi eats the other half n nobody says anything. thats love. thats the whole food court.

blog.title: the lavender incident (8th grade) (i have the yearbook)
blog.body: ok so in 8th grade i decided i was gonna be a white-blonde. lexi's mom said we could do it in the bathtub if we put towels down. we did not put towels down. step 1: bleach. 40 min. my head felt like a lit candle. step 2: toner. the box said 'ash.' it did not say 'ash.' it said 'ASH' in a font that lied. step 3: rinse. i looked in the mirror. LAVENDER. not 'lavender-ish.' like a grape soda. 9 days. i had school pictures on day 4. the yearbook says 'melissa (misery!!)' under my picture n there is a rawr in the corner n my hair is the exact color of a wizard. lexi's mom came in n looked at the tub n said 'oh. oh no. the grout.' we are banned from the tub. the tub is still a little purple. kitty says its 'part of the house now.' i said its a monument. lexi said its a crime scene. all true. my hair is white now. i did it right. i did it in my OWN bathtub. my mom bought towels. she said 'for the love of everything, towels.'

dms: my mom watched video #1 at 4am after her shift. she didnt tell me. i found out bc the views went from 212 to 213 n her browser history said 'misery hair vid.' she watched it 3 times. she left a note on the fridge: 'the cat part is the best part. do not rawr at the neighbors.' im not ok

mr alvarado asked me to stay after rehearsal. i thought i was in trouble. he said 'melissa, im giving you the solo.' i said 'is it a breakdown.' he said 'its a minuet.' i said 'it can be both.' he said 'we'll see.' i rawr'd in the parking lot. a violist saw. she nodded

my nana called me 'melissa ann' for 40 min straight n i said 'yes nana' every time n didnt rawr once. she gave me a plate of pastelitos n said 'u look tired mija.' i said i was. she said 'sleep.' im going to. goodnight. rawr

the lady at the orange chicken counter gave me an extra scoop today. i said why. she said 'u look like u need it.' i said 'i have 2 sets of lashes. im fine.' she said 'extra scoop.' i love her. i dont know her name. i call her the scoop
